# NONoise

> AI SDLC bootstrapper. The `create-nonoise` CLI scaffolds projects with AI skills, a docs hierarchy, per-tool context files and the Polly orchestrator, and upgrades existing ones.

## For agents asked to install or update NONoise in a project

- [UPDATE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/UPDATE.md): step-by-step runbook (detect case, `npx create-nonoise@latest --upgrade <path>`, `doctor`, post-upgrade steps; the upgrade updates the `codebase-memory-mcp` code graph, retires graphify, installs the Regia mod for Claude Code and removes pristine copies of the retired `swarm-router`, `copilot-delegate` and `gemini-delegate` skills)

## Docs

- [Installation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/docs/installation.md): prerequisites, native vendors, the `codebase-memory-mcp` code graph (`--code-graph-only`), Haft, profiles
- [Install profiles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/docs/install-profiles.md)
- [Development modes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/docs/development-modes.md): quick / medium / long (`/polly quick|medium|long <goal>`), the FPF gate, how Codex and Copilot apply the same modes
- [Regia](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/docs/regia.md): the orchestration layer for Claude Code (`regia@claude-regia`): `/regia long|medium|quick`, model and effort per task, swarms of Claude, Codex and Qwen Code agents, how NONoise installs it, what it replaces, limits
- [Contributor guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/CLAUDE.md)
